card.title: The Gāyatrī Mantra
card.sub: Seer Viśvāmitra · to Savitṛ, the Sun

characters.Viśvāmitra: The sage Vishvamitra: an elderly rishi with a long white beard and matted hair tied in a topknot, ochre robes, rudraksha beads, serene face, seated in lotus posture.
characters.Savitṛ: Savitr, the golden Sun god: radiant golden-armed deity crowned with a sun-disc halo, riding a golden chariot drawn by seven white horses.
characters.Gāyatrī Devī: Goddess Gayatri: five serene faces and ten arms, seated on a red lotus, holding conch, discus, lotus and rosary, a white swan beside her, soft golden-white radiance.

scenes.title: The three worlds at dawn
scenes.description: Pre-dawn beside a sacred river. The three worlds as one tall vista: dark earth and river below, misty sky in the middle, a starry heaven above fading into the first light. In the lower third the sage sits in meditation on a stone ghat, seen in three-quarter view from behind.
scenes.motion: Mist drifts slowly across the river while the stars fade into the first light.
scenes.camera: Camera slowly tilts up from the river to the sky.

scenes.title: Savitṛ rises
scenes.description: Sunrise over the river horizon. Within the great rising golden sun disc, the Sun god rides his golden chariot, seated calmly holding two lotuses, while Aruna, the red-skinned charioteer of dawn, holds the reins in front of him. The chariot is drawn by exactly seven white horses fanned out in a wide staggered team, all seven heads clearly visible. Golden rays spreading across the sky and reflecting on calm water.
scenes.motion: The sun's rays slowly widen and brighten, and light shimmers on the water. The god and the horses stay still.

scenes.title: We meditate on the radiance
scenes.description: Close three-quarter view of the sage in deep meditation, eyes closed, hands in dhyana mudra, a soft column of golden radiance descending on him; the faint form of the Goddess glows within the light above.
scenes.motion: A column of golden light slowly descends onto the sage, with dust motes floating in it.

scenes.title: Light awakens the mind
scenes.description: Full sunrise. A luminous golden lotus opens at the sage's heart, its light spreading out over the river; on the distant ghats devotees offer water to the sun and small diyas float on the river.
scenes.motion: The golden lotus slowly opens its petals while small diya flames flicker on the river.
